Gold Prices Experience Significant Drop, Analysts Predict Volatility

Gold prices have seen a substantial decline, falling below $4,000 per ounce and experiencing the largest monthly drop since 2008. Analysts suggest potential rebounds due to oversold conditions, but note that volatility will likely persist, influenced by US interest rates and geopolitical events.
